sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Cleaning/chores robots are near-ubiquitous household equipment, not merely a successful appliance category.
reference.rationale: IFR’s 23.2 million consumer/domestic robot sales in 2019 show a large market, not near-universal household presence. Useful cleaning robots are established, but near-ubiquity across households and the broad chores range are not demonstrated.

evidence.title: IFR: Service robots record sales worldwide
evidence.note: 23.2 million consumer/domestic service robots sold in 2019, +34%. broader.rationale: Substantial sales and established manufacturers support this normal market-language reading of widespread, without literal near-universality.
